moves.label: Crane Jab
moves.description: Fast high jab that checks close pressure with a short, compact strike.

moves.label: Low Crane Sweep
moves.description: Steady low sweep that slips under highs but stays punishable on block.

moves.label: Psychic Palm
moves.description: Quick mid palm thrust with a faint psychic flare for steady close-range control.

moves.label: Telekinetic Roundhouse
moves.description: Committed mid kick with a wide arc that keeps Chiaotzu close for extensions.

cmd:f+1.label: White Sash Rush
cmd:f+1.description: Advancing mid shoulder rush that rewards timing wins with extra counter-hit stun.

cmd:d/f+2.label: Psychic Lift
cmd:d/f+2.description: Unsafe mid launcher that pops the opponent upward with a telekinetic palm lift.

cmd:qcf+4.label: Dodon Ray
cmd:qcf+4.description: Ki-cost yellow Dodon Ray shot that reaches far but leaves Chiaotzu punishable if read.

cmd:WS+4.label: Rising Crane Kick
cmd:WS+4.description: While-standing mid kick that lifts lightly out of crouch pressure.

cmd:FC+1.label: Crouch Palm Check
cmd:FC+1.description: Quick crouching mid palm that interrupts pressure without giving big reward.

cmd:FC+2.label: Low Psychic Pop
cmd:FC+2.description: Full-crouch psychic pop-up that starts juggles but is launch-punishable on block.

cmd:1+2.label: Telekinesis Hold
cmd:1+2.description: Steady mid psychic bind that wins timing wars but stays minus on guard.

cmd:1+3.label: Psychic Launch Rush
cmd:1+3.description: Forward-moving mid launcher that cashes out a hard read with real block risk.

cmd:2+3.label: Crane Low Feint
cmd:2+3.description: Low feint that ducks under highs and leaves Chiaotzu close but punishable.

cmd:2+4.label: Sweeping Crane Kick
cmd:2+4.description: Slow low sweep with wide coverage that knocks down but is heavily punishable on block.

cmd:3+4.label: Spinning Crane Crush
cmd:3+4.description: Spinning mid kick that works as a tornado extender and route-ending knockdown.

cmd:O+2.label: Psychic Paralysis
cmd:O+2.description: Expensive psychic burst that locks the opponent down on hit but carries clear recovery risk.
